title: Weekly, Twice-Monthly or Monthly Installments on Your Home-Site Lease Repayment Plan
content:
**Home-Site Lease — how often repayment installments fall**

The schedule of a Home-Site Lease repayment plan follows how the resident has paid in the trailing 6 calendar months, counting the payments received on the lease in that window.

| Payments received on the lease in the trailing 6 calendar months | Installments fall | Installments per plan month |
|---|---|---|
| 20 or more | weekly | 4 |
| at least 9 but fewer than 20 | twice a month, on the rent due day and on the fifteenth | 2 |
| fewer than 9 | monthly, on the rent due day | 1 |

In every schedule the first installment is due on the rent due day of the next month.

### Questions on the schedule

*Where are the boundaries?* 20 payments give the weekly schedule and 19 the twice-monthly one; 9 payments give the twice-monthly schedule and 8 the monthly one.

*How many installments does a plan carry?* The number of plan months, each carrying the installments per plan month shown above: a plan of 5 plan months on the weekly schedule carries 20 installments, on the twice-monthly schedule 10, on the monthly schedule 5.

*Hypothetical.* A resident who paid every week by portal for the past six months, 26 payments in all, signs in May: installments fall weekly, the first on 1 June.
